cues.text: From below, Aigis looks down. The view narrows, like eyes closing, and goes black.
In darkness, a glowing blue butterfly flutters past, trailing sparks.
Light returns. Across the rooftop, Aigis sits on the bench beside the hero.
Her gloved hand rests on his.
A stairwell. Light floods through the doors at the top.
The doors open onto the rooftop.
At the door stand Yukari, Mitsuru, Akihiko, Junpei, Fuuka and Ken, with Koromaru.
Ken hugs Koromaru up off the ground.
Aigis looks at them. Her face softens.
